origin: User specifically cites Buzz Lightyear and Woody as examples of WTF crossovers and asks for additional recommendations
rules: Source-era version and original size/bodies/temperament govern. Even ridiculous guests choose from actual needs, can leave and can influence Runeterra independent of Sins; no immediate powerscaling, immortal toonforce, new adult status, teleportation or guaranteed plot. Require explicit author approval before adding a candidate as selected arrival.

suggestions.name: Woody and Buzz Lightyear
suggestions.origin: Toy Story originals (toy-sized, Buzz as actual toy not the Lightyear human)
suggestions.hook: A real Noxian merchant accidentally sells them as enchanted artifacts; Woody tries to return to his child while Buzz attempts Star Command protocol with Darius.
suggestions.mechanical_limits: Toy dimensions, Woody pull-string, Buzz toy light/wing mechanics, toy freeze-in-front-of-people condition where version applies.
suggestions.fit: Best tonal whiplash / actual dual-character tension.

suggestions.name: Shrek and Donkey
suggestions.hook: Shrek discovers a Noxian governor trying to legally annex his new swamp while Donkey asks everyone for directions and friends.
suggestions.mechanical_limits: Shrek ogre strength and attachment to home, Donkey actual talk/personality; no wish-granting or instant portal.

suggestions.name: Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz and Perry the Platypus
suggestions.hook: Doofenshmirtz markets a hyper-specific -inator to a Black Rose patron while Perry covertly sabotages it and TPP attempts a hostile takeover.
suggestions.mechanical_limits: Inventions require hardware and real triggers; Perry's agent persona and silent cover remain, no infinite gadget.

suggestions.name: Mordecai and Rigby
suggestions.hook: Two slackers hired to sweep an arena accidentally become responsible for containing a Noxian magical incident.
suggestions.mechanical_limits: Have separate relationship, strengths and slacker habits; paranormal events not automatic authored powers.

suggestions.name: Wallace and Gromit
suggestions.hook: Wallace is commissioned to fix a harbor lift; Gromit discovers someone fitted the same lifting rig to steal its cargo.
suggestions.mechanical_limits: Wallace human inventor with accessible machinery and cheese motives; Gromit dog is intelligent and non-speaking, no magic.
suggestions.fit: Inventive rivalry with Chris and real canine dynamics with Mana.

suggestions.name: Shaggy and Scooby-Doo
suggestions.hook: They mistakenly expose an actual Noxian secret society while hunting a supper and trying to flee supernatural danger.
suggestions.mechanical_limits: Source-version cartoon dog can speak to some people; fright/food motives, detective skill and source-appropriate slapstick; no absolute plot armor.

suggestions.name: Yzma and Kronk
suggestions.hook: Yzma tries to sell transformation potions to a rich Noxian while Kronk accidentally befriends the people she targeted.
suggestions.mechanical_limits: Potion needs real brewing/stock; Kronk capable, loyal but morally conflicted, not helpless; Yzma cunning not omniscient.
suggestions.fit: Black Rose court alchemy versus incompetent sales pitch.

suggestions.name: Penguins of Madagascar
suggestions.hook: Four elite self-important penguins infiltrate a Noxian naval depot to steal a fish shipment, then stumble onto serious naval plans.
suggestions.mechanical_limits: Small animal bodies, teamwork and improvisation, no human-level unearned strength.

suggestions.name: Courage the Cowardly Dog and Eustace
suggestions.hook: An unnerving Shadow Isles wanderer follows a farmhouse that shouldn't be moving, forcing Courage to defend his cruel owner.
suggestions.mechanical_limits: Dog-sized Courage, supernatural setting yes but no free world altering, courage comes despite fear.

suggestions.name: Mr. Bean
suggestions.hook: One ordinary man unintentionally ruins a Noxian state ceremony while attempting to retrieve a misplaced lunch.
suggestions.mechanical_limits: No superpowers or universal immunity, mostly physically comic silence, genuine geography.

suggestions.name: SpongeBob and Squidward
suggestions.hook: A Bilgewater captain fishes up a very loud sponge and an artist octopus who just wants to go home.
suggestions.mechanical_limits: Source-specific undersea biology, air/water rules and artistic drives; no arbitrary cartoon physics or unlimited powers.

suggestions.name: Ed, Edd n Eddy
suggestions.hook: Three kids try to sell a fake magical relic to TPP; their plan somehow collides with an actual Noxian relic auction.
suggestions.mechanical_limits: Source-appropriate child status, no adult romantic eligibility, no unrealistically adult organization or instant invention.

suggestions.name: Kuzco and Pacha
suggestions.hook: An obnoxious displaced emperor tries to reclaim a random field as his royal palace while Pacha deals with the actual Noxian farmer.
suggestions.mechanical_limits: Source time/version and shapeshifting conditions; Kuzco arrogant not automatically gifted politically.
